title: Lapse Advance on Reinstatement, Community Rules & Site Care Billing Table
content:
A lapse advance of the plan fee in force is added to the reinstatement payment under Community Rules & Site Care by the whole calendar months from the most recent plan fee charged on the statement to the handling date.

| Whole calendar months from the most recent plan fee to the handling date | Lapse advance |
|---|---|
| 4 or more | 1 month of the plan fee in force |
| 2 or more, fewer than 4 | 0.5 month (one half) of the plan fee in force |
| fewer than 2 | none |

The advance is added to the payment after every amount allowed to stay on the statement has been subtracted and the zero floor applied.

## Hypothetical cases

Handling date 9 October, plan fee in force of $60.00, chosen for illustration:

| Most recent plan fee dated | Whole months to 9 October | Lapse advance |
|---|---|---|
| 1 June | 4 | $60.00 |
| 1 August | 2 | $30.00 |
| 1 September | 1 | none |

At 3 whole months the advance is one half month; at 4 it is a full month.
